# Third-party code

These folders hold code written by other people that this repository needs.
Each is kept as it was received (apart from removing duplicate and
autosave files) and stays under its own licence or terms. If you redistribute
this repository, keep these notices.

| Folder | What it is | Original author(s) | Licence / terms |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hierclust2nmf` | Hierarchical clustering of hyperspectral images with rank-two NMF (v2), incl. `nnlsm_blockpivot` | Nicolas Gillis, Da Kuang, Haesun Park | as distributed by the authors; cite Gillis et al., IEEE TGRS 2015 |
| `canny` | `canny.m`, Canny edge detector returning magnitude and orientation | unknown | see file header |
| `yarpiz_dbscan` | `DBSCAN.m` | Yarpiz (www.yarpiz.com) | BSD-style, per file header |
| `zhuo_sim_defocus_2011` | `sparseBilateralFilter.m` | Shaojie Zhuo, Terence Sim | **Academic use only** (see `README.txt`) |
| `guided_filter_boxfilter` | `boxfilter.m` | Kaiming He et al. | as distributed by the authors |
| `read_envihdr` | `read_envihdr.m`, ENVI header parser | Jarek Tuszynski | MATLAB File Exchange terms |
